claim: The GIE implementer's guide officially sanctions building a fully custom EPP as one of two first-class integration options, rather than treating it as an unsupported workaround.
stance_target: implementing a custom EPP/router for non-k8s backends is a legitimate, project-sanctioned strategy
quoted_support: Implement your own EPP: Create a custom external processing service that implements the Endpoint Picker Protocol specification.

claim: The repository's own reference EPP implementation (lwepp) is explicitly marked not recommended for production use requiring high performance or advanced scheduling, implying custom/third-party EPPs are expected for real deployments.
stance_target: building a custom EPP is expected practice, not an edge case
quoted_support: This repository provides a Lightweight Endpoint Picker (lwepp) under pkg/lwepp. However, it is intended only as a reference for testing and conformance, and is not recommended for production environments where high performance and advanced scheduling are required.

claim: Both documented options for a Gateway controller to track InferencePool endpoints (shadow Service creation, or direct endpoint tracking) are described in terms of discovering Kubernetes pods via label selectors, indicating the endpoint-tracking side of the architecture assumes a pod backend even though the wire protocol does not.
stance_target: the surrounding InferencePool/data-plane architecture assumes k8s pods even where the ext-proc wire protocol itself does not
scope_conditions: GIE Implementer's Guide, Endpoint Tracking section
quoted_support: the controller would use the label app: vllm-qwen3-32b to discover the pods matching the criteria, and get their endpoints (i.e. IP and port number). It would then need to monitor these pods for health and availability.

claim: A single fallback endpoint can additionally be set via the x-gateway-destination-endpoint-fallback metadata key in the same envoy.lb namespace, beyond the ordered list covered by proposal 004 as fetched.
quoted_support: In addition to the chosen endpoint, a single fallback endpoint CAN be set using the key x-gateway-destination-endpoint-fallback in the same metadata namespace as one used for x-gateway-destination-endpoint.
